_comment: Catalyst Calendar config. Where the five-score model says WHAT is wrong now and the timeline says WHY NOW, this says WHAT'S ABOUT TO HAPPEN. Almost everything we ingest carries a date; a catalyst is a FUTURE-dated event that will move a parcel (a loan maturing, a hearing, foreclosure eligibility, an entitlement expiring). Two ways a catalyst enters: (1) EXPLICIT -- a record already carries a real future date (rezoning hearing date, ground-lease expiration); pass it straight through. (2) DERIVED -- a present-dated signal implies a future milestone at a known offset (tax delinquency -> foreclosure eligibility ~2yr later). Derived offsets are approximations and carry a note; explicit dates always win. imminence: closer catalysts weigh more (a maturity in 20 days beats one in 300).
